script_text: Aries, the cosmos is igniting a fire under your foundations this week like never before. Late week, Mercury enters your 5th House Thursday, sparking flirty texts and a love spark with someone bold; weekend favors creative risks as Moon conjuncts Neptune Saturday in your 12th.
